messages:
kevin-partners: Heads-up: Aurora signed the NDA and we kicked off the on-prem EAP. Need to align bench plan + telemetry requirements this week. @anya can you confirm lab dates?
anya: Yep — NDA came through yesterday. Lab access confirmed for Mon 04/24, 3 racks (2 nodes each). We need a checklist: bench script, dataset whitelist, telemetry fields, and handoff doc.
maria: I uploaded an initial bench script v0.2 to the shared drive (link below). It expects our quantized runner and needs kv-cache tuning for 2k seqs. Drive: https://drive.redwood/aurora/eap/bench-v0.2
kevin-partners: Aurora asked for limited telemetry under the NDA. Can we provide per-token latency, p99, GPU power, and VRAM pressure at 1s sampling? Also need to hide host identifiers.
anya: Proposed telemetry subset: [per_token_latency, p99_latency, sm_util, power_watts, vram_used_mb]. Sampling 1s, redact host_id, and strip mac addresses. I'll create JIRA INF-3421 and attach the runbook.
maria: Bench note: we'll run model=redwood-xl-8x quant=4bit, seq=2048, batch=1, iter=20. Evalset is aurora-smoke-v1 (10 prompts) to validate correctness before full run.
jordan-aurora: From Aurora side — CSV+JSON exported reports fine. One ask: embargo any public numbers until partner sign-off and legal clears the summary. Also we'll provide KMS-wrapped telemetry keys.
lia-legal: Confirmed — legal reviewed the telemetry subset and NDA. We can proceed with the limited fields; partner approval required before public summaries. I'll send the sign-off email to the thread.
infra-bot: Lab allocation scheduled: Mon 04/24 09:00-17:00 UTC. Reserved racks: R1-R3.
anya: Dry-run planned for Fri 04/21 12:00 UTC. I'll post the runbook snippet here and link artifacts.
maria: Run command snippet: ```
./run_bench.sh --model redwood-xl-8x --quant 4bit --seq 2048 --iters 20 --telemetry-file /tmp/telemetry.csv
```
sam-qa: I'll join the dry-run and run the smoke evals, plus check inference outputs for regressions.
kevin-partners: Quick punchlist: 1) INF-3421 created by @anya, 2) bench-v0.2 in drive (maria), 3) legal sign-off (lia-legal), 4) dry-run Fri 12:00 UTC (team), 5) embargoed report handed to Aurora for approval. Any blockers?
jordan-aurora: No blockers from Aurora. :thumbsup: We'll encrypt telemetry keys with our KMS and share access.
kevin-partners: Awesome — thanks all. I'll update the partnership tracker after the dry-run and ping for roll window. :tada:
